title: Two-level nested loop
summary: Each iteration of the outer loop reruns the entire inner loop from start to finish, determining the total number of task executions.
context: Here n is a positive integer, i controls the outer loop, and j controls the inner loop.
result: Every value of i runs through the full range j = 1 to n, so the task executes n × n = n² times in total.

frames.title: Two-level nested loop
frames.explanation: First set i = 1 and test i ≤ n. When true, enter the inner loop, reset j = 1, and test j ≤ n: if true, execute the task, increment j by 1, and return to the inner check; if false, exit the inner loop, increment i by 1, and return to the outer check. Whenever the outer condition still holds, the next round starts over at j = 1; the entire process ends only when the outer condition becomes false.
